items.title: Ivory 2027 with Garden Flowers
items.alt: Ivory 2027 numerals edged in gold, surrounded by coral flowers, small blue daisies and green leaves.
items.description: The asymmetrical flower arrangement follows the base of the first digits and rises around the final seven.

items.title: Welcome 2027 Spring Flower Wreath
items.alt: Welcome 2027 lettering inside an oval wreath of pink tulips, yellow flowers, white daisies and small blue blossoms.
items.description: A gold Welcome ribbon crosses the upper center while the navy year remains clear within the complete flower ring.

items.title: Cozy New Year 2027 Knitted Greeting
items.alt: Blue knitted Cozy New Year 2027 lettering wrapped in a red scarf, with a pom-pom cap and two pale snowflakes.
items.description: Thick yarn loops define each large letter, and both scarf ends remain visible beneath the year.

items.title: Hello 2027 Seashell Greeting
items.alt: Coral Hello 2027 lettering across a cream scallop shell with green palm leaves, a blue wave and an orange starfish.
items.description: The ridged shell provides a compact shape behind the greeting while the wave curls up one side.

items.title: Adventure Awaits 2027 Mountain Patch
items.alt: Round Adventure Awaits 2027 patch with three mountain peaks, pine trees, a reflective lake and rising sun.
items.description: Cream curved lettering follows the navy outer border above a rust-colored year banner at the base.

items.title: Next Stop 2027 Suitcase
items.alt: Teal wheeled suitcase with a cream Next Stop ribbon and four hanging number tags spelling 2027.
items.description: A small airplane and curved blue trail rise beside the extended handle, with a tiny travel tag at the top corner.
